'''Contispex XI''' was a [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who served the [[Pius Dea]] faith. Around [[11,591 BBY]], Contispex XI instigated the [[Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade]], a conflict waged against the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwins]] of [[Old Barag/Legends|Old Barag]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> In response, [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] military veterans of the [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellin religion]] formed the [[Tayan League]] to resist against the crusade.<ref name="SOR" />
